label: PF Backlog 674
title: Review material-change decision API and correct delta-review base
body: Review budget blocks legitimate fix deltas because HIL MATERIAL_CHANGE decisions cannot be recorded through the backlog API, and re-review base selection rejects a valid earlier reviewed head. Add an operator-only decisions endpoint and make delta-budget exemption require a reviewed ancestor base plus a reason citing the latest review SHA.

brief.problem: HIL MATERIAL_CHANGE cannot be recorded via API; review budget blocks valid fix deltas.
brief.what_adds: Operator-only decisions endpoint plus reviewed-ancestor delta base.
brief.why: Keeps review enforcement compliant while allowing evidence-based re-reviews.

objective: Unblock legitimate fix deltas without weakening review-budget enforcement or requiring direct backlog mutation.
acceptance_criteria: The backlog API exposes an operator-only endpoint to append a MATERIAL_CHANGE decision with mode, reason, HIL confirmation and revision guard, and the item stores it for review_budget.
Delta re-review budget exemption accepts any reviewed ancestor as --since, requires the reason to cite the latest review SHA, and rejects arbitrary caller-supplied SHAs.
Tests cover API auth/validation, decision persistence, accepted reviewed-ancestor delta, and rejection of arbitrary or non-reviewed bases.
in_scope: Review material-change decision API and correct delta-review base
approach: Add an operator-only decisions endpoint that appends validated MATERIAL_CHANGE decisions through core.backlog.update, and fix architect_review delta budget to accept any reviewed ancestor base with a reason citing the latest review SHA.
verification: material-change decision persists with HIL fields
risks: A permissive decisions endpoint could bypass review; restrict to MATERIAL_CHANGE, require hil_confirmed and hil:<actor>, keep revision guard.
Arbitrary --since could bypass budget; require the SHA to be a reviewed head and an ancestor of HEAD.
rollback: Remove the decisions route and restore strict latest-SHA delta exemption; no data migration.
summary: Adds API-only HIL MATERIAL_CHANGE recording and allows correct reviewed-ancestor delta re-reviews without budget bypass.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/budget.py, core/budget_allocator.py, core/budget_conservation.py, core/budget_planner.py
